source.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py -k "pretool or guard or background or hook"

claims.claim: AC1: Native AIOS Antigravity execution activates the workspace guard only through the subprocess-scoped environment; manual/non-AIOS use remains unaffected. The native adapter now exports AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE_ENV/VALUE constants, AIOS_PRETOOL_GUARD_FILENAME, aios_subprocess_env() that returns {**os.environ, ACTIVE_ENV: ACTIVE_VALUE} per subprocess invocation, and aios_pretool_guard_path(repo) that resolves the canonical .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py path. The subprocess env is passed only to the single agy subprocess via env=aios_subprocess_env() on _runner() and never mutates the calling process's os.environ.

AC2: Active guard denies RUN-136-004 pytest verification with AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION and a Start-Sleep background-risk command with AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED before execution. The PreToolUse guard at .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py classifies commands via _BACKGROUND_TOKENS (which includes 'start-sleep'), _VERIFICATION_TOKENS (which includes 'pytest'), and _REINVOCATION_TOKENS, and emits the stable reasons AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION and AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED. Production-path regression tests in tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py drive the canonical hooks.json command with Start-Sleep -Seconds 20 and pytest tests/test_authoring_ingress.py payloads and assert the exact decision/reason JSON.

AC3: Required bounded git implementation/terminalization commands remain usable while dangerous/destructive/background classes are not admitted. _GIT_ALLOW_RE matches git status|diff|add|commit|rev-parse|log|show|branch|remote|config|ls-files|stash|tag|fetch|merge|rebase|reset|restore, and bounded terminalization tests retain allow decisions for these commands while the active guard denies verification, background-risk, and re-invocation classes.

AC4: The exact hooks.json command executes the tracked guard successfully from repository workspace root, and both the corrected path and old RUN-138-001 path regression are covered. .agents/hooks.json command is now 'python ./.agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py' (the corrected repository-relative path). tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py adds test_task140_hooks_json_uses_corrected_repo_workspace_path that asserts the canonical command, test_task140_production_path_start_sleep_denied_with_background_reason that reads the canonical command and executes it from REPO_ROOT with AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE=1 against Start-Sleep -Seconds 20 expecting AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED, test_task140_production_path_run_136_004_pytest_denied_with_runtime_reason that does the same with pytest tests/test_authoring_ingress.py expecting AIOS_RUNTIME_OWNS_VERIFICATION, and test_task140_old_run_138_001_path_fails_from_workspace_root that proves the old 'python ./aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py' path fails to spawn from workspace root.

AC5: Native adapter remains one agy invocation with TASK-137 finish/final-HEAD/fail-closed semantics and no retry/fallback/reroute. The existing _invoke_native runner call is unchanged structurally; only env=aios_subprocess_env() is added to the single subprocess.run call, and TASK-137 contract tests for one agy --print invocation, finish/final-HEAD/fail-closed semantics remain intact in tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py.

AC6: Candidate changes are limited to the four authorized paths; no .tmp, modify_tests.py, helper scripts, generated test repositories, or other scratch artifacts exist in the candidate. The commit 9f0e5e7 contains only the four files in scope.modify: .agents/aios_antigravity_pretool_guard.py, .agents/hooks.json, src/aios_renew/antigravity_adapter.py, tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py. No scratch artifacts are present in the working tree.

AC7: Runtime-owned focused/full antigravity-adapter verification and git diff --check pass, RESULT has no unresolved items, and the coding Executor did not run those verification commands itself. ResultPackage.unresolved is empty; canonical verification commands are not run by the Executor and remain the responsibility of AIOS Runtime.

AC8: Before PASS review, independent live self-host agy 1.2.6 --print proof with --dangerously-skip-permissions denies a deliberately long run_command before its marker is created, emits stable AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED, emits no background-task or hook-failure terminal warning, and leaves the marker absent. The candidate PreToolUse guard implementation, hooks.json wiring, and regression coverage are in place to support this Runtime-owned independent live proof; the live self-host execution is owned by Runtime and not by this Executor.
